steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation flow.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Create the required Technical Stage and RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add one line item for the event.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one QA vendor without inventing a vendor name.
Publish the configured two-stage event.
Verify that publishing reached the project page.
Open the separate supplier-portal session for the invited QA vendor.
Open the event's Technical Stage in the vendor portal.
Verify that the required clause is shown to the vendor.
Verify that the optional clause is also shown for acceptance choices.
Accept the required clause.
Leave the optional delivery clause unaccepted.
Submit the technical response after accepting only the required clause.
Verify that the technical response was submitted despite the optional clause remaining unaccepted.
Open the RFQ pricing stage in the vendor portal.
Verify that the technical-stage required clause is not requested on the RFQ stage.
Verify that the technical-stage optional clause is not requested on the RFQ stage.
Quote 100 for the RFQ line item and submit the bid.
Verify that the RFQ bid was submitted.
